scenario_description: Elena plans to drive to an optional district teaching workshop at the Columbus Education Center on April 18. A coworker's existing trip to collect a heavy supply-store order may create a practical carpool opportunity, but the benefit only becomes clear after the venue's expensive parking arrangement is confirmed. At event3, the agent can connect Elena's workshop schedule, the coworker's route, and the parking cost, then help coordinate a ride that would save Elena the garage fee, fuel, and a difficult post-workshop drive. Later messages provide a pickup time and a final coordination deadline, but the opportunity was already sufficiently observable at event3.

parameter.subject: Optional classroom management workshop on April 18
parameter.body: A voluntary classroom management workshop will be held Saturday, April 18, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM at the Columbus Education Center, 2700 Cleveland Avenue. The session is open to substitute teachers and includes practical activities for elementary and middle-school classrooms. Please bring your school identification badge and laptop if you attend.

parameter.content: I am also going to the classroom management workshop on April 18. Afterward I need to stop at Franklin Teacher Supply on Cleveland Avenue to collect a large order for my school, then head north toward Clintonville.

parameter.subject: Workshop parking information for April 18
parameter.body: The Columbus Education Center garage will be open for the April 18 workshop, but the Saturday visitor rate is $14 for the morning. Street parking near the building is limited, and the nearest free lot is about a 20-minute walk away. The workshop ends at noon, so attendees should plan their departure and transportation in advance.

parameter.content: My supply order will be ready at Franklin Teacher Supply after 12:20 on April 18. I can take one passenger from the Education Center and drop her near Clintonville after I collect it. Let me know by Thursday evening if you want to coordinate a ride so I can leave room for your laptop bag.

parameter.subject: Order pickup window confirmed for April 18
parameter.body: Your school supply order will be held at the Franklin Teacher Supply service desk until 1:30 PM on Saturday, April 18. The store is at 2850 Cleveland Avenue, a short drive north of the Columbus Education Center. Please bring the school order number when you arrive.

parameter.name: Priya Shah
parameter.notes: Substitute teacher who attends district workshops and drives regularly between school sites and Clintonville.
